My plot is very small, just a small piece behind the house, and I have no schooling but I have been growing maize since I was a boy. If the coupon comes from the government I will use the fertilizer, but one bag of 23-21-0 and one bag of urea is too much for my little plot, so I share with my brother who farms next to me — we split the bags and each put some on our maize. I keep a few goats and chickens so I carry their droppings to the plot before the rains, this I have always done. I plant the hybrid seed my neighbors plant because last year the one who used it got more cobs, and I put pigeon pea and pumpkin between the maize lines like my father taught me.
